story: Commercial Holiday Decorators is the commercial division of a Southwestern Ontario holiday-lighting company that has been decorating properties since 2016. We are based in London, Ontario and serve hotels, office buildings, condo and apartment lobbies, shopping plazas and malls, restaurants, property management portfolios, municipalities and BIAs across Southwestern Ontario, the Greater Toronto Area and Hamilton-Niagara. Our sister brand, We Install Christmas Lights, handles residential work. This site is for the people who manage buildings for a living.

We started on rooflines and trees in London neighbourhoods, learning the trade the practical way: which strings survive freezing rain, how to wrap a mature tree so it reads as solid light from the street, how to run a crew in December without letting quality slip. Those years built the habits we still work by. Commercial-grade LED product only, clean installs, timers on everything and a phone that gets answered when a section goes dark.

The commercial division grew out of requests from the residential work. A homeowner who managed an office tower asked about the lobby. A restaurant owner asked about the patio and the roofline. A property manager asked whether we could do a whole plaza overnight so tenants were not disrupted. Each of those jobs needed more than lights: a site visit, a design, lifts, insurance paperwork, after-hours crews, maintenance through the season, a January takedown and somewhere to store it all.

That is how we work now. We design from a site visit or from plans and photos, supply everything from our own inventory so we can warranty it, install with insured and WSIB-compliant crews using our own bucket trucks and aerial lifts, maintain the display all season at no charge for any fault, take it down in January and store it labelled in our warehouse. Most clients lease the decor per season under a multi-year agreement. One price, one invoice, and a lobby or frontage that looks right every year.

values.title: Say what we will do, then do it
values.body: Every proposal lists the scope, the product, the install window and what is included in maintenance, takedown and storage. We reply within one business day, we show up in the window we agreed and we tell you honestly when something is not worth doing.

values.title: Own the product, own the problem
values.body: Everything we install is our own commercial-grade inventory. That is why we can promise no charge for any fault during the season, why replacements match, and why we do not install customer-supplied lights. If it fails, it is ours to fix.

values.title: Work around the building, not through it
values.body: Hotels, condos and plazas do not close for us. We install after hours or overnight, cone off only the area we are working in and keep lobbies, drives and parking open. The morning shift should arrive to a finished display and nothing else.

values.title: Build for next year, not just this one
values.body: Labelled storage, priority dates and multi-year agreements exist so the second season is easier than the first. We note what to improve at takedown, hold your product and your dates, and come back in summer with a plan already half written.

whyUs.title: Our own inventory, warrantied
whyUs.body: Commercial-grade LED strings and C9 bulbs, pre-lit lobby trees from 7 to 20+ feet, garland, wreaths, planters, cone trees and giant trees, all from our warehouse. Because we own it, we test it, track it and replace it at no charge.

whyUs.title: Insured and WSIB-compliant crews
whyUs.body: Our installers are insured and WSIB-compliant, and we provide certificates of insurance and WSIB clearance for your vendor file at proposal stage. We work at height from our own bucket trucks and aerial lifts, never from a ladder on a gutter.

whyUs.title: After-hours and overnight installs
whyUs.body: Guest arrivals, tenant traffic and deliveries keep moving. We agree an install window with your building staff, work overnight where it suits the property and leave a finished display with no ladders, packaging or cords across a lobby.

whyUs.title: Season-long maintenance included
whyUs.body: A dark tree section, a tripped circuit, a timer knocked out after the time change or a plug pulled by a snowplow is fixed when you call, at no charge. On larger programs we do our own drive-by checks so many faults are fixed before anyone notices.

whyUs.title: January takedown and labelled storage
whyUs.body: Takedown runs through the first three weeks of January, after hours where needed. Everything is tested, labelled by property and location and stored in our warehouse. Your mechanical room and storage cage stay empty, and your product is ready on your reserved date next season.

whyUs.title: One program, one invoice
whyUs.body: Design, product, installation, maintenance, takedown and storage on a single seasonal price with a deposit at signing and the balance after install. Multi-year agreements lock pricing and dates, which is what property managers, hotel GMs and boards need for budgeting.

process.title: Site visit & brief
process.body: We walk the property with you from July to September, measure rooflines and trees, check lobby ceiling heights, outlets and lift access, and listen to what the display needs to do for your guests, tenants or shoppers. Plans and photos work when a visit is not practical.
detail: 30 to 60 minutes on site with a decision maker if possible
Linear footage, tree count and height, power and lift positions recorded
Events and lit-by dates noted so the schedule is built around them

process.title: Design & proposal
process.body: We design a scheme matched to your brand or interior finishes, with ribbon and ornament samples you can see in the space. The proposal lists scope, product, install and takedown windows, and shows the seasonal lease and purchase options side by side.
detail: Colour scheme carried through trees, garland, wreaths and planters
Lease and buy options priced on the same scope
Insurance certificate and WSIB clearance available for vendor setup

process.title: Agreement & scheduling
process.body: A short agreement confirms the scope and the dates. A deposit reserves your install window and lets us pull product from inventory or order custom pieces. We confirm after-hours access, power and parking for lifts with your building staff before anyone arrives.
detail: Multi-year agreements lock pricing and schedule for the term
Early bookings get first pick of October and November dates
Night contacts, keys and blackout periods confirmed in writing

process.title: Installation
process.body: Exterior work goes in from October using our bucket trucks and aerial lifts. Interior trees, garland and wreaths go in through November, overnight for hotels and malls, after hours for offices and condos, so the display is lit before late November.
detail: Work area coned off and kept small, walkways and drives open
Every circuit tested and every timer set before the crew leaves
Walkthrough with your staff and a contact number for the season

process.title: Season-long maintenance
process.body: Any fault in the display is fixed at no charge through the season. The truck carries matching strings, bulbs and timers because the product is ours. Timer changes for events are a phone call, and larger programs get our own drive-by checks.
detail: No charge for any fault, including snowplow and weather damage
Replacements match because everything is from our inventory
Timers adjusted after the time change and for late events

process.title: Takedown, storage & rebooking
process.body: The same crews remove the display in the first three weeks of January, after hours where needed. Everything is tested, labelled by property and stored in our warehouse. Returning clients get priority dates, and multi-year clients already have next season booked.
detail: Specific takedown dates held for events or lobby use
Plain warm-white lighting can stay up as winter lighting on request
Notes from takedown feed next summer's proposal

guarantees.title: Reply within one business day
guarantees.body: Every request, from a first enquiry to a dark section in December, gets a response within 24 hours on a business day. Call 519-266-6796 or send a request and you will hear from a person who knows your property.

guarantees.title: No charge for any fault, all season
guarantees.body: If anything we installed fails between install and takedown, we fix or replace it at no charge. That covers product, timers, weather and snow-clearing damage. It is possible because everything on your property is our own inventory.

guarantees.title: Insured, WSIB-compliant, on lifts
guarantees.body: Our own crews do the work, insured and WSIB-compliant, from our own bucket trucks and aerial lifts. Certificates are provided for your vendor file before install, and nobody on your staff ever needs to climb a ladder.

guarantees.title: Down in January, stored by us
guarantees.body: Takedown is scheduled in the first three weeks of January and everything is labelled and stored in our warehouse. Nothing is left in your mechanical room, and your product and dates are held for the next season.

serviceAreaBlurb: We are based in London, Ontario and serve commercial clients across Southwestern Ontario, including London, Windsor, Sarnia, Kitchener-Waterloo, Guelph and Stratford, the Greater Toronto Area from Mississauga and Oakville through Toronto to Markham and Vaughan, and Hamilton-Niagara including Burlington, Hamilton, St. Catharines and Niagara Falls. For larger programs such as hotel portfolios, shopping centres, campuses and municipal displays we travel beyond those areas. Call 519-266-6796 and we will confirm coverage for your property within one business day.
